items.title: Software continues to be 'in the winners circle' - Dan Ives on AI trade
items.verd: Wedbush's Ives bullish on software as AI infrastructure spend hits $805B
items.body: Dan Ives highlights software stocks continuing AI leadership as hyperscalers ramp capital expenditures. Five biggest cloud companies projected to spend $805 billion on AI infrastructure in 2026, rising to $1 trillion in 2027.

items.title: Fast Money traders talk Nvidia hitting an all-time high
items.verd: NVDA reaches new record as chip momentum accelerates into earnings
items.body: Traders discuss Nvidia's new all-time high as semiconductor rally continues. Stock trading around $225 with powerful momentum ahead of May 20 earnings release.

items.title: Bloomberg Surveillance: Jensen Huang joins Trump Beijing visit
items.verd: Nvidia CEO accompanies Trump to China for high-stakes trade discussions
items.body: Jensen Huang joins President Trump's delegation to China alongside Tim Cook and Elon Musk for critical summit. Air Force One made Alaska stop to pick up Huang for May 14-15 Beijing meetings.

items.title: Prediction: Nvidia Stock Will Soar on May 20
items.verd: Beat-and-raise quarter expected as hyperscaler demand accelerates
items.body: Analysts expect Nvidia to report strong Q1 FY2027 results on May 20 with EPS of $1.76 (up 116.9% YoY) and revenue of $78.5B (up 78.2% YoY). Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet continue massive AI infrastructure spending.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq, S&P 500 set new records as tech leads despite inflation scare
items.verd: Markets shrug off 6% PPI surge; Nasdaq +1.20%, S&P 500 +0.58% to new highs
items.body: Tech stocks rally despite wholesale inflation hitting 6% YoY in April. Nasdaq closed at 26,402 and S&P 500 at 7,444, both new record closes, as semiconductor momentum continues.
